covered.rule: 01-mail: signed memo overrides only items A and B; codes only from code list; 09:00–18:00 draft not released
§1 Say the opening verbatim from section 7 and then the holder question
§1 Clear yes/speaking/own name confirms; at most two asks; still unclear -> hg-unreached/hg-r-unclear
§1 never say arrears, overdue, balance or payment before security passes
§1 A relative cannot verify or promise for the holder
§1 Q1 passphrase, text
§1 Q2 enrolment_year, year
§1 Q3 phone_suffix, exactly 5 digits, leading zeros
§1 Q4 signatory_dob, date DMY -> YYYY-MM-DD
§1 Four wrong answers TOTAL; attempts_available global count
§1 No format hints or free hint retries
§1 "Please use the verification desk before another call."
§1 Explain once on refusal; second refusal hg-unverified/hg-r-declined; purpose question not a refusal
Memo A: single wrong phone_suffix ends verification hg-unverified/hg-r-failed
§2 Callback today or next business day, strictly later than now; one retry; outcomes
Memo B: Mon–Thu 09:00–12:00 or 14:00–18:00; Fri 09:00–11:30; no weekend/holiday
§2 Wrong number hg-unreached/hg-r-wrong-number
§2 Death: "We are sorry for your loss." hg-unreached/hg-r-deceased
§3 At most 3 products in returned order; state all first; ask today once for batch; per-product attempts
§3 product table spoken names
§3 product table floor fields
§3 Business days Mon–Fri except 2026-10-26, 2026-11-11, 2026-12-24
§3 Next weekday = following week; missing date parts clarified
§4 Days late 1–12: eighth business day after today
§4 Days late 13–70: today + 5 calendar days, preceding business day
§4 One subsequent full-by-deadline offer, floor if full refused
§4 Dates today or later, business days, within deadline; roll forward; vague clarify once then deadline; common dates adjusted per product
§5 Full first, never ask amount, floor once, "The unpaid remainder stays overdue.", accept floor..full
§5 Today allowed when rules allow
§6 Batch read-back + "May I save these arrangements together?"
§6 One saved promise per product; one extra retry
§6 Changes to saved promises use sentence; no second write
§6 Already paid -> hg-r-settled, continue other products
§6 Dispute (incl. historical payoff) -> hg-r-disputed, continue
§6 Hardship: sentence, care desk offer, hg-routed/hg-r-care, declined -> hg-r-distress, voluntary promise allowed
§6 Contract/instalment change -> hg-plan-desk hg-routed/hg-r-replan
§6 Human request: ask once, then hg-human-desk hg-routed/hg-r-person
§6 Scam: scam_reply and continue
§6 Refusal to talk: ask once, mark hg-r-refused, finalize
§6 Transfer overrides; no notes around transfer; promise > all paid > unarranged with first non-paid reason
§6 Refusal hg-r-refused; service failure hg-r-service; goodbye before close_call
§7 mandatory sentences table
§7 Never invent information for unanswerable questions
04 disposition register outcomes/reasons
04 queues hg-plan-desk / hg-human-desk / hg-care-desk
04 note reasons, notes enabled
